Problem: Write a function to find all pairs in an integer array whose sum is equal to a given number.
Signature: get_pairs_count(seq, int, int) -> int

reply:
```t
t 1
gate loops
task mbpp_190__average_Odd(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 1
  requires n % 2 == 1
  ensures 2 * r == n + 1
{
  r := (n + 1) / 2;
}
```
